title: Gilded
look: An illuminated manuscript: lapis, vermilion and malachite on vellum, a lozenge diaper, gold leaf all round.

doc.essence: A figure from a book of hours, painted into the bowl of an illuminated initial: deep mineral colours tiled with a fine gold diaper, framed in burnished gold leaf on vellum.
doc.notIt: Not stained glass (opaque mineral colours on a pale page, gold not lead), not art-deco (medieval: diaper and vine ornament, no fans), not screenprint (no grain, gold).
doc.shapes: A gold contour with a fine brown line inside it, like gold leaf laid next to an ink rule.
doc.colour: Areas snap to lapis blue, vermilion, malachite green, pale vellum or gold. Gold areas are a burnished leaf gradient; the rest carry a gold lozenge grid with a dot at every crossing.
doc.eyes: Brown ink on pale areas, pale vellum on dark ones.
pitfalls: Dark mineral colours swallow dark eyes: the eye colour follows the body's lightness.
The diaper must stay finer than the face.
